entries.axis_a: D1 Procedure knowledge is free text

value.objective: A real SOP, OWL file or BPMN diagram becomes a draft procedure through procedures.ingest_*.

entries.axis_a: D2 A drafting job could publish its own output

value.objective: Publishing requires a human decision; the drafting job cannot publish its own procedure.

entries.axis_a: D3 Re-ingest forked the published row

value.objective: A re-ingest creates the next draft version; the published row keeps its source and pack.

entries.axis_a: D4 An unreviewed source could bind a job

value.objective: A bound job runs the PDDL steps; an unreviewed source never binds.

purpose: Why the capability exists, in the programme's own terms.
title: Driver, goal and objective catalogue — T16 procedure ingestion (retrospective, 2026-11-23)
